prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, take it, check, and finish the specific task. Otherwise, approach, move, or scan. list of available nodes: <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />  <Action ID = GrabObject    />  <SubTree ID = TaskSubTree    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectVerified    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />  <Action ID = ApproachObject    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectInRange    />  <Action ID = MoveToObject    />  <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO TaskSubTree
	END
